transforms.name: copy
transforms.effect: derive copies host.account and otherwise omits the property.

transforms.name: vibefield-host
transforms.effect: hostRunFromSummary copies profileId and profileSet and never sets account.

transforms.name: puppeteer-host
transforms.effect: This host sets account from the profile label when profileId is registered.

transport.name: host-scoped
transport.contract: Vibefield omits account. Puppeteer Godview host may set a profile label.
